escapes.name: T1 straight-ahead escape
escapes.source_note: Opening left turn with a straight paved escape. Preserve the close temporary spectator structures, following T2 arm and separate pit exit. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

escapes.name: T3 straight-ahead escape
escapes.source_note: Opening third-corner escape remains ordinary asphalt. Preserve the returned racing arm and the protected public-road edge. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.
